 At the pump Petrol, diesel, and heating fuel prices drop again 
 Tom Nols From midnight, prices for 98 and 95 petrol, as well as diesel and heating fuel, will fall across Luxembourg. Published: 19.11.26 18:42 © Domingos Oliveira / RTL (Archiv) Motorists in Luxembourg will see lower fuel prices from midnight, with reductions affecting both petrol and diesel, as well as heating oil. The price for a litre of 95 petrol will decrease by 3.6 cents, bringing the new price to €1.559 per litre.
 Similarly, a litre of 98 petrol will also become 3.6 cents cheaper, with the new price set at €1.692 per litre from Friday onwards.
 Diesel will see a slightly larger drop, with the price per litre falling by 4.6 cents to €1.904.
 Heating fuel is also being reduced, with a price cut of 5 cents per litre. Consumers will now pay €1.387 per litre.
